answer_1.quote: As a final downstream application, we train a phrase-conditional LLM on discrete sign representations, identical to MusicGen . The model accepts four sequences of integers from a quantizer together with the phrases to be signed and generates four parallel sequences of tokens.
answer_1.outputs: four parallel sequences of tokens that can be decoded into signs

answer_2.quote: We use normalized total Levenshtein distance as a metric for our comparisons since this is the metric that was used in the competition . It is defined as (N -D)/N , where N is the total number of characters in all of the labels and D is the total Levenshtein distance for all the examples.
